scenes.text: ChatGPT *ads* just went live in *89 countries*

scenes.title: What *changed*
lines: Oct 21: OpenAI opened ChatGPT ads in 26 more countries, 89 total, with a self-serve Ads Manager.
Ads show only on the Free and Go plans. Over 100,000 advertisers already.

scenes.title: The *money* use
lines: Small sellers can now buy ChatGPT ads the way they buy Meta ads.
Test one product with a tiny budget before your niche catches on.

scenes.title: *Tested*, not hyped
lines: OpenAI said ads hit a $1 billion annual run rate in August. Early inventory is cheap; that won't last.

scenes.title: The *cost*
lines: Self-serve, pay as you go. OpenAI hasn't published a minimum spend.
Paying ChatGPT users never see them, so you reach the free crowd only.
